QuestInfo.name: General's Second Test
QuestInfo.0: Go to #b#p3001102##k and take the second test to become a general.
QuestInfo.1: Listen to the problems of various people of Nova, especially #b#p3001107##k and #b#p3001105##k, and lend a helping hand.
QuestInfo.2: You passed the second test. Talk to #b#p3001102##k about the final test.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:

Can proceed to the General's Final Test quest

0.0: I'll go over the second test. Knight captains have to use their brains to make split decisions for the good of their troops.
0.1: Go speak to the people in town. Get an understanding of the troubles they face, the problems that plague them. When you understand what it means to be defenseless, you'll be tested on how well you can make sacrifices for the good of all.
0.2: #b#p3001107##k and #b#p3001105##k are both in need of some help. You should start there.
0.3: How was it? Are you ready to test your virtues?

yes.0: If you're ready, lend an ear to #b#p3001107##k and #b#p3001105##k. Both of them are at the #r#m401040000##k.

no.0: I think you should take a little more time before the test starts.

1.0: People in high positions should always put others before themselves. Good work.
1.1: Remember that a leader is only as good as those that follow.

quest.0: Please help #b#p3001107##k and #b#p3001105##k resolve their problems. You should be able to find them over at#r#m401040000##k.
